summary: Lixte Biotechnology Holdings, Inc. (the registrant) entered into a merger agreement as the acquirer of Nomad Transportable Power Systems, Inc. via a wholly owned merger sub. Shareholders of Nomad will receive a pro rata portion of up to 50,500 shares of newly designated Series D Convertible Preferred Stock ($1,000 original issue price, convertible into up to 50.5M common shares at $1.00/share) and up to 3M common shares. Unaccredited Nomad shareholders get cash based on the 60-day VWAP. The closing is conditioned on Lixte having at least $16.5M unrestricted cash, among other conditions. A stockholder meeting to approve conversion of the preferred stock is required within 60 days post-close. Watch for: satisfaction of the cash condition, shareholder approval, and potential Nasdaq listing.
